comments: No Friday Night Connection tonight as "there is so much new stuff to cram in!"
I'm fairly certain Tommy mixes up the information that Underground Zero are touring with Hawkwind, saying it is Wildfire!
Steve Marriott's new release is promised by Tommy at the beginning of the show but is sadly not on the recording.
